
### Choosing a PR template

When you open a PR, the **default template loads automatically**, fill it in completely. Blank, description-less PRs will be asked to use it.

If you'd prefer a focused checklist for your change type, open your PR using one of these links (each pre-loads a specialised template). Replace `YOUR-BRANCH` with your branch name:

- **Feature** — `https://github.com/GS-SystemAnalyzer/core/compare/main...YOUR-BRANCH?template=feature.md&expand=1`
- **Bug fix** — `https://github.com/GS-SystemAnalyzer/core/compare/main...YOUR-BRANCH?template=bugfix.md&expand=1`
- **Performance / memory** — `https://github.com/GS-SystemAnalyzer/core/compare/main...YOUR-BRANCH?template=performance.md&expand=1`
- **CI / infrastructure** — `https://github.com/GS-SystemAnalyzer/core/compare/main...YOUR-BRANCH?template=ci_infra.md&expand=1`
- **Documentation** — `https://github.com/GS-SystemAnalyzer/core/compare/main...YOUR-BRANCH?template=docs.md&expand=1`

Already on the "Open a pull request" screen? Just append `?template=feature.md&expand=1` (or any of the names above) to the page URL and reload.

> GitHub only shows a template picker for **issues**, not PRs, so the default template is the one everyone gets, and these links are the way to reach the typed ones.
